name: Poly Fighter
description:
About This Game

FIGHT. ADAPT. OVERCOME!

Welcome to Poly Fighter, a unique roguelike fighting game. Step into the ring in a single-player arcade showdown where every defeat teaches you, and every win transforms your fighter into something stronger.

A FIGHTING GAME BUILT FOR SOLO PLAY

No ranked ladders. No online stress. Just pure, expressive 1v1 combat.
Choose your path through escalating leagues and make every choice count.

BUILD YOUR MOVESET WITH EVERY WIN!

Earn new moves with every opponent you defeat, then swap and upgrade to craft devastating synergies.

Will you become a zoner, a grappler, or a rushdown menace? Build your destiny!

EASY TO LEARN, DEEP TO MASTER

The choice of simple and motion inputs means everyone can pull off flashy combos and pick up new moves quickly, and the many movesets you can build offer endless potential for expressive fighting.

3 UNIQUE GROOVES

Customize your experience and play your way:

  • Classic Groove: The standard Poly Fighter experience.

  • Cozy Groove: Take things at your own pace with up to 5 optional modifiers to make your runs more approachable.

  • Fierce Groove: Push your skills further with modifiers that make every run more challenging and unpredictable.

ENDLESS BUILD POTENTIAL

Unlock a massive cast of playable characters each with unique perks. Combined with an enormous list of possible moves to learn from each opponent, there are thousands of possible build options for you to find.

EARN YOUR TITLE!

Rise through 3 leagues and test yourself in ascension runs. Every run will provide different moves to pick from, making no single run the same!

RETRO COOL MEETS MODERN FEEL

Inspired by the classics of the genre, Poly Fighter delivers nostalgic visuals with snappy animations, responsive controls and a banging soundtrack!

FEATURES:

  • Single-player one-on-one matches.

  • Roguelike progression where every win lets you add new moves or replace old ones.

  • Approachable controls that anyone can pick up and thrive with!

  • Deep Discovery Loop to unlock new characters.
short_desc: Poly Fighter is a single-player roguelike fighting game. Learn new moves from every opponent you defeat to build your fighter’s unique style. Battle through tense retro-arcade duels with beginner-friendly controls to master your moveset and claim your title!
